caption: The drawing features a single teapot positioned centrally within a square boundary. The teapot has an ornate and rounded body, rendered primarily in shades of gray, with subtle shading used to suggest a metallic surface. The spout projects to the left side and is elongated and narrow, maintaining a silvery-gray coloration consistent with the main body. The lid is dome-shaped with concentric rings and a finial on top, also shaded in gray. The handle on the right side is large, curving upward and outward in a broad arc; it is depicted in brown tones, which contrasts with the body of the teapot, and is shaded to indicate its three-dimensional form. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the drawing is signed by Charles Cullen in the lower right corner within the square boundary. The entire composition is centered on a light, cream-colored paper.
title: Pewter Teapot
